name: Catalan
description: White repertoire against the Catalan. Nine chapters: Open Catalan (...a6 b5, ...a6 Nc6, direct ...Nc6, and ...c5), Closed Catalan (...e6/...d5, and with ...dxc4 already played), and the ...Bb4+ check lines (Closed, Open, and Bogo move orders).

excluded.reason: Study annotates this as inferior: Nc6 follows and the b4 square is weak.
